root.label: Name Lookup & ADL
root.note: Maps identifiers to candidate declarations before template deduction, overload resolution, and access control run.

children.label: Lookup Pipeline
children.note: Runs strictly before deduction, overload ranking, and private/protected access checks.

children.label: Name Hiding First
children.note: Inner scopes stop lookup before parameter types are ever compared.

children.label: Access Checking Last
children.note: Overload resolution can select a private best match and then fail access control.

children.label: Unqualified Lookup
children.note: Searches outward through enclosing blocks, classes, and namespaces until the first match.

children.label: using-declarations
children.note: Brings base or namespace names into the current scope so overloads stay visible.

children.label: using-directives
children.note: Exposes namespace members from the nearest common enclosing namespace for unqualified calls.

children.label: Qualified Lookup
children.note: Inspects only the named class or namespace scope and disables ADL.

children.label: Scope Qualifier ::
children.note: Confines search to the target namespace or class hierarchy while ignoring caller directives.

children.label: Injected Class Name
children.note: Places the class's own name inside its scope so templates and constructors resolve.

children.label: Argument-Dependent Lookup
children.note: Extends unqualified function calls into the associated namespaces and classes of arguments.

children.label: Associated Namespaces
children.note: Contributed by class types, bases, enclosing namespaces, and template arguments.

children.label: Hidden Friends
children.note: Inline friend definitions inside a class are callable solely via ADL.

children.label: ADL Suppression
children.note: Blocked by scope qualification, parentheses around callee, class members, or block declarations.

children.label: Two-Phase Template Lookup
children.note: Separates non-dependent lookup at template definition from dependent lookup at instantiation.

children.label: Phase 1 (Definition)
children.note: Resolves non-dependent names early and ignores dependent base classes like Base<T>.

children.label: Phase 2 (Instantiation)
children.note: Looks up dependent calls via ADL in instantiation context, missing fundamental types.
